question:
**Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.**

Break fresh/new ground

options.text: To do something that was not done before

solution:
The correct answer is "**To do something that was not done before.**"

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• An idiom is a group of words, or in other words, a phrase that has a meaning different from the literal meaning of the words in it. 
 
 
• **Example:** Break the ice. Meaning: To get the conversation going.
 
 
 
• **The idiom "break fresh/new ground" means to do something innovative or original**.
 
• कुछ नवीन या मौलिक करना।
 
• It is often used in the context of research, inventions, or creative endeavors.
 
 
• Example:** **This recovery technique breaks new ground. 
 
 

Hence, **the correct answer is option 2**.
